component.name: Rebost
component.summary: Private AI that works with your files

description.p: Rebost runs an AI on this computer and answers questions about the documents kept here. Questions go in Chat, the answer is generated locally, and each answer cites the files it drew on. What happens on your computer stays on your computer.

ul.li: Shelves: point a Shelf at a folder and Chat searches it, quotes what it finds and links each citation back to the file
Reads PDFs, scanned documents, Office files, spreadsheets, email and web pages
Recipes: prompts saved once and reused with any Shelf
House rules: standing instructions for every conversation
Uses the graphics card through Vulkan, or the processor when there is none

description.p: The first launch offers an AI sized for this computer's memory and downloads it. No account is needed. Rebost uses the network to find and install an AI. Documents are not uploaded, and web lookups stay off until they are turned on.

description.p: Rebost reaches 1.0.0. This maintenance release adds no new features: it polishes 0.9.9 and updates the components inside Rebost, including what runs the AI.
Choose where AIs are kept and how many files each Shelf reads. Long scanned PDFs get the time they need, and Rebost now runs on Linux.
Keep more than one AI. Settings lists the other installed AIs under the one in use, and installing a new AI keeps the previous one.
First-run picks use the current open-weight scores, and Chat runs Shelf tool calls that some AIs write as text.
